title: The Death God Jinnai Murder Case
notes: Recurring detective-cast nodes (Conan, Kogoro Mouri, Inspector Megure) omitted by convention; Ran does not appear in this episode. No `event` node type: every action is a directly typed, attributed edge between the entities involved (person/location/object), sharing an `order` integer so edges belonging to the same occurrence can be grouped without a reifying node. 'Shinigami Jin'nai' is the villain of Nanjo's own in-universe movie series, not a real person -- modeled as a costume/disguise object the culprit wears, not a person node. Per task instructions, temporal_frame follows the (Flashback) tag literally: only lines explicitly tagged (Flashback) are backstory (the car-stunt killing of Kitano 3 years prior, and Nanjo's drunken confession to Yoshino ~1 month prior); Yoshino's recounting of finding Kitano's diary and joining the agency is delivered as present-tense dialogue without a (Flashback) tag and is therefore kept temporal_frame:present even though it chronologically precedes the confession. case_type: murder.

objects.name: Death-threat note ("I am coming for Hayato Nanjo tonight. -- Shinigami Jin'nai")

attrs.purpose: written by Yoshino and, at her suggestion, used by Nanjo to promote the movie -- doubling as the pretext that lured the TV crew and detectives to stake out the building that night

objects.name: Vinyl tape and fishing line rig

attrs.mechanism: zigzagged vinyl tape on the window formed a person-shaped silhouette; fishing line ran from the elevator, through the office light switch, to the tape roll; calling the elevator down pulled the line, switching on the light and pulling the tape into a crouching shape, then catching on the elevator and snapping, leaving the roll behind
attrs.staging_flaw: the silhouette was seen operating the light switch while standing at the window, but the switch is mounted beside the door -- physically impossible for one real person to do both

objects.name: Cassette tape with gunshot recording, loaded in the office stereo

attrs.mechanism: 15 minutes of blank tape recorded before the gunshot sound, played on an auto-reverse stereo so the gunshot appeared to happen roughly 15 minutes later than the real murder
attrs.side_effect: auto-reverse silently replayed the same gunshot exactly 60 minutes later, catching Yoshino off guard while she was downstairs retrieving the fishing line
attrs.discovered_state: found alone in the machine, still warm, and not rewound

attrs.received: delivered by fax machine to the office during the murder
attrs.significance: one page carries bloodstains and a machine timestamp proving the real time of the murder, 15 minutes before the staged gunshot was heard downstairs

attrs.description: the bolt that secures a car's front wheels, removed by Nanjo from Hiroyuki Kitano's stunt car
attrs.kept_by: Nanjo, as a trophy; later shown to Yoshino while drunk

attrs.why_convincing: Yoshino's background as an action-movie stunt actress let her move nimbly enough to be mistaken for the costumed 'Shinigami Jin'nai' and evade the chase

objects.name: Claimed video tape of "Shinigami Jin'nai" in the park

clues.desc: The fax page delivered during the murder is bloodstained and machine-timestamped 9:59 PM, but the group only heard the staged gunshot from the cassette tape about 10:15 PM -- the 15-minute gap between these two independently-timed pieces of evidence proves the murder happened well before the 'gunshot' was heard, exposing the audio-delay trick.

Witnesses saw the silhouette turn the office light on while it stood at the window, but the light switch is fixed beside the door on the opposite side of the room -- the impossible geometry between the witnessed position and the switch's real location shows the 'figure' at the window was not a person operating the switch, but a rigged mechanism.
